business_problem: As teams shift from generative AI experimentation to production, scaling video creative assets has emerged as a major operational bottleneck. While ad platforms allow for strategic audience targeting, the production of creative video assets remains a manual, linear process. Their next step was building out the specialized video assets needed to engage this high-value audience
solution_summary: To execute the campaign, The Points Guy deployed a custom GenAI media agent powered by Gemini and Veo 3 within Google’s GenAI Media Suite. The agentic architecture automates the video life cycle using specialized sub-agents. With Gemini and Veo 3 on Google Cloud, The Points Guy automated video ad production, driving 67,000+ conversions. Veo 3 provides high-fidelity video rendering capabilities, transforming text and image prompts into tailored video scenes. By deploying these technologies, The Points Guy built an automated creative engine capable of accelerating experimentation, expanding their creative toolkit, and unlocking high-intent business outcomes at scale. This agentic approach compresses production schedules from months into minutes and yields up to 10x more creative output variants. Pairing GenAI Media Suite with Veo 3’s advanced rendering, The Points Guy enabled true hyper-personalization.
